title: Does what it’s supposed to do
text:
Does what it’s supposed to do. Super easy to install, and has given a new life and feel to our couches.

We used to have couches that would sag and hurt our backs, but now we feel like our couches have a couple more years of life in them.

They also help my in-laws to be able to get off of the couch where as before, they needed help to get up and off.

product_metadata.title: LAMINET Deluxe Extra Thick Sagging Furniture Cushion Support Insert- | Seat Saver| New and Improved| Extend The Life of Your Large Sofa | 60% Thicker-Large Sofa- Up to 88" Wide
features: RESTORE YOUR FURNITURE: Restore, Lift and Fix Sagging Large Sofa - (17”L x 88”W). Laminet’s Large Sofa Cushion Saver is the perfect solution to help prevent your cushions from sagging and to restore their original firmness and support. Over time your cushions sag, losing their lift and support. Springs within your couch typically concentrate body weight, which can cause your cushions to sag. Our cushion savers help distribute the weight evenly, resulting in sturdier, firmer cushions.

NEW DELUXE EXTRA THICK - HEAVY-DUTY WOOD BOARD - Made with heavy-duty vinyl-covered Engineered Wood board (17 x 88 in.) Laminet's new and improved version; 60% thicker than competing brands! The thick panels provide more comfort and support. Engineered for strength, the sturdy wood does not break or fall apart and is used in the furniture making. The soft non-slip vinyl layer with rounded edges makes sure your couch stays safe. No tearing, ripping, no harming the inner workings of your sofa.

EASY TO INSTALL: Slips under seat cushion to renew firmness and comfort. No tools required! The solution to your sagging Large Sofa cushions only takes seconds to remedy. Simply remove your cushions, place in the center, then put the cushions back into place and enjoy your couch with renewed firmer cushions. Our couch savers fit most standard sized Large Sofas. To provide extra lift for areas that are sagging, you can fold over our panels for additional support!

CORRECT YOUR LARGE SOFA AND POSTURE - KEEP THE SHAPE OF YOUR CUSHIONS. Improves posture while making cushions upright again. Over time, the shape of your cushions become misshapen due to uneven weight distribution. Our cushion savers help support sagging cushions and prevent your cushions from sinking and keeps them upright. The vinyl layer also wipes clean in case of any spill that reaches below your cushions!

SAVE MONEY TRUST 60 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE: Working with experts who actually make sofa cushions, Laminet's product development team - with 60 years of experience - has developed the original and best cushion support. With our cushion savers, you don’t need to purchase a new couch! Refresh your sofa cushion and your old Large Sofa with our cushion saving support inserts and you’ll instantly feel the difference. Get the feel of a new couch with our inserts without breaking the bank.
